why: A plate of the Russian Menaion Reader (Жития Святых, 1903–1911), whose file names carry the church-year date: «11141» is church-month 11 = July, day 14, plate 1. The 14 July Julian is this folder's own Russian and Serbian feast day, and the plate is titled «Акила» — the exact Russian name form this folder already stores. The only other plate on that day is «Еллий», a different man. Not the Greek 14 July «Άγιος Ακύλας» of `aquila-14-july`: that saint has no Russian day and no Russian Lives entry, and this plate stands in the Russian book on the Russian day, which is the apostle of the Seventy.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08301»: church-month 08 = April, day 30, which is this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate's own title is «Иаков Зеведеев», James son of Zebedee, by-name and all — it names the father, so no other James can be meant.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «12021»: church-month 12 = August, day 2, this folder's feast in the Russian, Greek and Serbian calendars. The Russian Lives keep one Basil on 2 August, the blessed fool-for-Christ of Moscow, which is this folder's `fool-for-christ` type and its Russian form «Василий Московский». It is the only plate the series carries for that day.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08173»: church-month 08 = April, day 17, this folder's feast in all three calendars that keep him. The plate is titled «Зосима» and the Russian Lives keep one Zosimas on 17 April, the abbot of Solovki — this folder's Russian form is «Зосима Соловецкий». The day's other two plates are «Симеон» and «Акакий».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08282»: church-month 08 = April, day 28, this folder's Russian and Greek feast. The plate is titled «Кирилл»; the Russian Lives keep one Cyril on 28 April, the bishop of Turov, which is this folder's Russian form «Кирилл Туровский». The day's only other plate is «Иасон, Сосипатр и Керкира».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «09283»: church-month 09 = May, day 28, this folder's feast in all three calendars. The plate is titled «Игнатий»; the Russian Lives keep one Ignatius on 28 May, the bishop of Rostov, which is this folder's Russian form «Игнатий Ростовский». The day's other plates are «Еликонида» and «Никита».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08242»: church-month 08 = April, day 24, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Елисавета», this folder's own Russian form; she is the only Elizabeth the Russian Lives keep on 24 April, the wonderworking abbess of Constantinople. The day's other plate is «Савва Стратилат», a man.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «12083»: church-month 12 = August, day 8, this folder's feast in all three calendars. The plate is titled «Емилиан»; the Russian Lives keep one Emilian on 8 August, the confessor and bishop of Cyzicus, which is this folder's Russian form «Емилиан Кизический». The day's other plates are the Tolga icon of the Mother of God and «Мирон».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «10081»: church-month 10 = June, day 8, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Ефрем»; the Russian Lives keep one Ephraim on 8 June, the patriarch of Antioch, which is this folder's Russian form «Ефрем Антиохийский». It is the only plate the series carries for that day.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «10202»: church-month 10 = June, day 20, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Мефодий»; the Russian Lives keep one Methodius on 20 June, the hieromartyr bishop of Patara, which is this folder's Russian form «Мефодий Патарский, Олимпийский». The day's only other plate is «Аристоклий, Димитриан и Афанасий».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «09191»: church-month 09 = May, day 19, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Патрикий»; the Russian Lives keep one Patrick on 19 May, the hieromartyr bishop of Prusa, which is this folder's Russian form «Патрикий Прусский (Брусский), Вифинский». It is the only plate the series carries for that day.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «07262»: church-month 07 = March, day 26, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Ириней»; the Russian Lives keep one Irenaeus on 26 March, the hieromartyr bishop of Sirmium, which is this folder's Russian form «Ириней Сирмийский». The day's other plates are the Synaxis of the Archangel Gabriel, «Малх» and «Василий».
